text:
maya: Starting a quarterly entitlement recon focused on KMS key policies + admin role bindings. Plan: run automated owner reports, filter noisy rotated keys, surface keys with >3 admins or no owner, and open tickets for remediation. Targeting remediation by EOD Fri. @jordan @luis can you eyeball infra-prod keysets?
jordan: SGTM. which artifact will you share? include project list so I can map to services.
maya: I'll post CSV to the ops bucket when done. command I'm launching now:
```
./tools/iam-recon --scope=org:redwood-prod --include-kms --include-roles --threshold=3 --output=s3://redwood-ops/iam-recon/1885001234.csv
```
ops-bot: Report generated: s3://redwood-ops/iam-recon/1885001234.csv (scan=432 items, high_priv=14)
luis: quick heads-up: last run flagged a bunch of keys that were rotated in the last week (false positives). can we exclude keys rotated <30d?
maya: good catch. will re-run with exclude-rotated-30d. updating command now.
maya: updated run:
```
./tools/iam-recon --scope=org:redwood-prod --include-kms --exclude-rotated-30d --threshold=3 --output=s3://redwood-ops/iam-recon/1885001234-filtered.csv
```
samir: For remediation workflow propose: 1) auto-create ticket with owner and observed bindings, 2) suggest least-privilege role for each principal, 3) if owner unresponsive after 72h escalate to sec. Also flag orphan keys for immediate read-only lock.
jordan: +1 to that flow. For immediate risk mitigation add a temporary policy to restrict admin bindings on orphaned keys and create alert on any new admin grants.
luis: we should also check KMS audit logging: ensure CMEK usage is in cloud audit logs and sink to security project. saw a gap last quarter.
maya: noted — adding a log-sink validation step to the script and will update the runbook. will open PR against infra-automation to wire ticket creation + temp policy. tagging @samir for runbook edits.
jordan: I'll validate the infra-prod list once you post the filtered CSV. Thanks folks :thumbsup:
maya: CSV posted: s3://redwood-ops/iam-recon/1885001234-filtered.csv. starting ticket creation run. will report back with counts and tickets.
ops-bot: Ticket creation run complete: 14 tickets opened, 3 orphan keys set to read-only, 2 escalations created.
